title: Space Whiskers: The Holy Cow
tagline: Pip, a mouse astronaut, in the cats' shipyard: a test level for his animations
description: The first playable piece of the Space Mouse remake: Pip at the game's own scale (49 pixels tall, on a 480 x 270 screen) walks, runs and jumps through a corner of the Whiskerworks shipyard, so his new animations can be judged in motion. Decks, crates, catwalks, a scaffold tower and a long run to the cheese.
controls: stick or d-pad, A jump, X or B run

walkSpeed.label: Walk speed
walkSpeed.help: Pip's walking speed in game pixels a second (he is 49 tall; the screen is 480 wide).

runSpeed.label: Run speed
runSpeed.help: His top speed while the run button is held.

jumpHeight.label: Jump height
jumpHeight.help: How high a full jump lifts his feet (hold the button; let go early for a short hop). 74 is about one and a half Pips.

jumpTime.label: Time to the top
jumpTime.help: How long a full jump takes to reach its top: lower is snappier (the game works out the gravity from this and the height).

walkStride.label: Walk stride
walkStride.help: How far he moves for each frame of the walk: the animation is driven by distance, so his boots keep pace with the floor at any speed.

screenWidth.label: Screen width
screenWidth.help: How many game pixels the view is wide (480 x 270 is the agreed screen); the window is filled in whole device pixels.
